Junk drawer of utility methods. 
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: UTF_8
variables.comment: A cheap and type-safe constant for the UTF-8 Charset.

methods.name: public static void checkOffsetAndCount(long arrayLength, long offset, long count)
public static boolean equal(Object a, Object b)
methods.comment: Returns true if two possibly-null objects are equal.

methods.name: public static void closeQuietly(Closeable closeable)
methods.comment:
* Closes {@code closeable}, ignoring any checked exceptions. Does nothing
   * if {@code closeable} is null.

methods.name: public static void closeQuietly(Socket socket)
methods.comment:
* Closes {@code socket}, ignoring any checked exceptions. Does nothing if
   * {@code socket} is null.

methods.name: public static void closeQuietly(ServerSocket serverSocket)
methods.comment:
* Closes {@code serverSocket}, ignoring any checked exceptions. Does nothing if
   * {@code serverSocket} is null.

methods.name: public static void closeAll(Closeable a, Closeable b) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Closes {@code a} and {@code b}. If either close fails, this completes
   * the other close and rethrows the first encountered exception.

methods.name: public static boolean discard(Source source, int timeout, TimeUnit timeUnit)
methods.comment:
* Attempts to exhaust {@code source}, returning true if successful. This is useful when reading
   * a complete source is helpful, such as when doing so completes a cache body or frees a socket
   * connection for reuse.

methods.name: public static boolean skipAll(Source source, int duration, TimeUnit timeUnit) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Reads until {@code in} is exhausted or the deadline has been reached. This is careful to not
   * extend the deadline if one exists already.

methods.name: public static String md5Hex(String s)
methods.comment: Returns a 32 character string containing an MD5 hash of {@code s}.

methods.name: public static String shaBase64(String s)
methods.comment: Returns a Base 64-encoded string containing a SHA-1 hash of {@code s}.

methods.name: public static ByteString sha1(ByteString s)
methods.comment: Returns a SHA-1 hash of {@code s}.

methods.name: public static List<T> immutableList(List<T> list)
methods.comment: Returns an immutable copy of {@code list}.

methods.name: public static List<T> immutableList(T... elements)
methods.comment: Returns an immutable list containing {@code elements}.

methods.name: public static Map<K, V> immutableMap(Map<K, V> map)
methods.comment: Returns an immutable copy of {@code map}.

methods.name: public static ThreadFactory threadFactory(final String name, final boolean daemon)
public static T[] intersect(Class<T> arrayType, T[] first, T[] second)
methods.comment:
* Returns an array containing containing only elements found in {@code first}  and also in
   * {@code second}. The returned elements are in the same order as in {@code first}.

methods.name: private static List<T> intersect(T[] first, T[] second)
methods.comment:
* Returns a list containing containing only elements found in {@code first}  and also in
   * {@code second}. The returned elements are in the same order as in {@code first}.

methods.name: public static String hostHeader(HttpUrl url, boolean includeDefaultPort)
public static String toHumanReadableAscii(String s)
methods.comment: Returns {@code s} with control characters and non-ASCII characters replaced with '?'.

methods.name: public static boolean isAndroidGetsocknameError(AssertionError e)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if {@code e} is due to a firmware bug fixed after Android 4.2.2.
   * https://code.google.com/p/android/issues/detail?id=54072
